# Third-party code

| Component | Source | Use |
|---|---|---|
| [Diffusion Policy](https://github.com/real-stanford/diffusion_policy) | `diffusion_policy/` | Push-T environment and rendering helpers |
| [Rocket Lander](https://gitlab.ethz.ch/bsaverio/coco-project) | `rocket_lander/` | Rocket simulator and linear dynamics model |

Diffusion Policy's MIT license is included in `diffusion_policy/LICENSE`.
Rocket Lander declares MIT in `rocket_lander/UPSTREAM.toml`, which also lists its
authors. Each dependency retains its own license.

See the [README acknowledgments](../README.md#acknowledgments) for the benchmarks,
baselines, datasets, and software used by this project.
